title: Exclude fixed-paid rank-five P104 prefix banks on chart 3→233
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Exact comparator #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

Both prime-field engines exclude all 17 owner-empty 3→233 public banks for roles 289 and 1052 on charts 329 and 340. Every original 65521 minor remains nonzero on independently reconstructed exterior rows at 65537. No selected key remains unresolved. The other 14 #7370 keys belong to two untested endpoint groups.

A productive 2+3 or 3+2 split would keep 110,519 paid positions and raise productive positions from 22,461 to 22,478. The complete-price optimistic upper is 0.207666506667591 raw per edit and 0.415333013335181 across the two eligible roles. No supported edit survives.

## Task and overlap

This continues `p104-side-correction` using the exact #7370 geometry at `a41edc3ae92332a7a1f1ba90e9ea4901d0530185`. That inventory left all 17 outside support testing. #7373 established the same gate on 3→238. #7374 tests a different rank-eight endpoint family. The research commit adds only `research/p104-rank-five-chart233-prefix-bound/`. The two existing #7257 commits address the canonical CI navigation mismatch documented in #7371.

## Validation

Run from a clean checkout with CPython 3.12.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-rank-five-chart233-prefix-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay authenticates the #7370 manifest, reprices the complete signed invoice, regenerates both modular receipts, and checks all original minor axes at the second prime. Altered selection, geometry and word are rejected. Add `--out fresh-directory` to retain all four receipts. Registered-package, committed-byte/source-history, navigation and export checks passed. No suffix, exact pairing or native prototype was needed after full prefix rank.

## Credit and open next questions

#7334 and #7113 supply the exact word and signed caller. #7370 supplies the frozen geometry and inherited price. #7373 supplies the independent replay workflow on its separate cohort. #7338, #7298, #7319, #5599 and #7367 supply the admitted invoice, directed arithmetic, helper census and split/support precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

The next fixed-paid question is whether either untouched seven-key cohort on 712→127 or 714→127 can supply exact two-sided support. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
